title: AI Workflow System
summary: A public guide to structured AI-assisted planning, building, review, and delivery.
tagline: A public learning platform at ai.davishiggins.com that turns the AI-assisted workflows I use every day into repeatable methods for planning, building, documenting, reviewing, and shipping work.
role: Built the platform and wrote its guidance, drawn from my own development and analytics workflows.
problem: Using an AI tool without context, a defined task, or a review step produces fast output that is hard to trust or maintain. Most beginner guidance focuses on prompts and tools rather than the process around them.
contribution: I built the platform and wrote its content. The material comes from the systems I use for real projects: task files, project memory, scaffolding, review loops, and shipping practices.
solution: The site organizes guidance around a repeatable process instead of tool hype: a free AI Workflow System framework, a Claude Code playbook covering task files, project memory, agents, and review loops, and a structured curriculum that starts with setup and builds toward a controlled Claude Code operating system.
solutionPoints: A practical framework for planning, building, reviewing, and shipping with AI.
A Claude Code playbook: task files, project memory, agents, and review loops.
A module-based curriculum that progresses from installation to a reusable operating system.
SEO-ready metadata and social previews on a fast single-page React and Vite build.

architecture.summary: A lightweight React and Vite content platform deployed on Vercel.
flow: Workflows I use on real projects

decisions.title: Teach a process, not a tool.
decisions.text: Task definition, context, and review generalize beyond any one model or product.

decisions.title: Treat review as part of execution.
decisions.text: Every workflow includes a verification step instead of trusting first output.

decisions.title: Lead with free guidance.
decisions.text: The core framework is available without an account so the method can be judged on its own.

outcomes: The platform is live at ai.davishiggins.com, and the companion notes on daily AI use and building the Claude Code course document the approach in more depth.
limits: This project was previously listed on the portfolio as "Davis Intelligence"; that name now belongs to this site's public assistant. Paid course availability and checkout are not described here; the live site shows what is currently offered.
lessons: Reliable AI-assisted work depends on task definition, context, and review more than on output speed.
